h1: DarGlobal - London-listed Luxury Real Estate Developer, Investor & Asset Manager
text:
# London-listed Luxury Real Estate Developer, Investor & Asset Manager

DarGlobal is a London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor and asset manager operating in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and London, across hospitality, commercial, entertainment and golf communities. Tagline: "Global Capital. Enduring Places."

## Key figures
Indicative figures aligned with disclosures as of Q3 2026: 32 years track record; $23B gross development value; 7 international markets; 12+ global brand partners.

## What DarGlobal does
- Developments: design-led residential and mixed-use projects, including towers in Dubai and Qatar and villas in Spain and the GCC.
- Communities: masterplanned and gated residential enclaves in the UAE and Europe.
- Hospitality & Leisure: hospitality assets run with global brands.
- Private Membership: planned private clubs, including one in Jeddah.
- Golf: golf courses and clubs anchoring premium developments.
- Commercial: income-focused commercial assets.
- Asset Management: Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), a DFSA-regulated subsidiary based in the DIFC, Dubai, investing in equity, debt and hybrid instruments.
- Tokenization: digital ownership structures aimed at improving liquidity and access.

## Brand collaborations
Aston Martin, Elie Saab, Fendi Casa, Lamborghini, Marriott, Missoni, Mouawad, Pagani, The Trump Organization, W Hotels and Paramount.

## Newsroom
- Nov 16, 2026: Dar Global expands its Saudi Arabia portfolio with a new mixed-use development in Jeddah valued at SAR 1 billion.
- Oct 26, 2026: Dar Global Capital Partners targets high-value real estate opportunities in Dubai.
- Oct 07, 2026: Sales open for Trump Villas at Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar.
- Sep 30, 2026: 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bn.
- Aug 06, 2026: Gulf Asia Contracting appointed for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai.
- Jun 29, 2026: Dar Global and FENDI Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman.

title: The Trump Organization - DarGlobal partner
text:
# The Trump Organization Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences

DarGlobal's collaborations with The Trump Organization include AIDA in Muscat, Oman (Trump International Hotel, Trump Golf Villas and Trump Cliff Villas), Trump Tower Jeddah in Saudi Arabia, and Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai. The partnership spans Dubai, Jeddah and Muscat, from the Trump Penthouses to Trump Tower Jeddah.

## Trump Plaza Jeddah
DarGlobal and The Trump Organisation expanded their Saudi portfolio with the USD 1BN Trump Plaza Jeddah, located within the Amaya development along King Abdulaziz Road in Jeddah (Trump Park Residences and Trump Executive Residences).

title: Mouawad - DarGlobal partner
text:
# Mouawad Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences

Mouawad partnered with DarGlobal on Neptune, a North Riyadh villa development that brings the jewellery house's mastery of rare materials into residential design. It is Mouawad's first move into luxury residential real estate. Neptune is valued at SAR 880 million (approximately GBP 180 million).

title: Dar Global and The Trump Organization launch SAR 2 Billion Trump Tower Jeddah
h1: Dar Global and The Trump Organization launch SAR 2 Billion Trump Tower Jeddah
text:
# Dar Global and The Trump Organization Expand Collaboration with the Launch of SAR 2 Billion Trump Tower to Transform Jeddah's Skyline

15/12/2024 - Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, announced the launch of Trump Tower Jeddah, a SAR 2 billion development in partnership with The Trump Organization. Located on Jeddah's Corniche, the 47-floor tower will be one of the city's tallest residential towers. The collaboration also includes the AIDA development in Oman and Trump International Tower Dubai.

title: Wasalt - Saudi Arabia's AI-backed real estate platform
h1: Wasalt - Saudi Arabia's AI-backed real estate platform
text:
# Wasalt - An Overview

Wasalt is an AI-powered real estate platform in Saudi Arabia dealing in both residential and commercial properties: sell, rent, buy or auction properties, browse new projects and daily rentals. It describes itself as a joint venture between Dar Al Arkan and Quara Holding, and a one-stop portal for premium and low-cost listings.

## What makes Wasalt different
- AI platform: partnership with propgenius.ai for AI-generated property descriptions, valuations and ROI predictions.
- Matchmaking: tell Wasalt your requirements and a broker finds the property for you.
- Auctions: partnership with the Entrustment and Liquidation Centre (Infath) for electronic and hybrid real estate auctions.
- Verified listings from trusted brokers; licensed by REGA (General Real Estate Authority) as a real estate portal.
- Ministry of Tourism licensed platform (licence #73106008) for daily rentals.

title: Wasalt corporate milestones
text:
# Wasalt milestones
